# Release-candidate defect and exception disposition

This is a controlled evidence template, not an accepted release finding. Generate the
current machine-readable disposition with `gfjd governance build`. Before acceptance,
an independent reviewer must verify that there are no open P0/P1 defects and that
every P2 exception is public, owned, approved, time-limited and unexpired.

Record the release candidate, pack checksum, review date, reviewer identity,
exceptions examined, conclusion, conditions and evidence-register update here.
